title: Multi-Modal Causal Disentanglement for Multi-Domain Sequential Audio Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33628v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern music platforms expose users to heterogeneous audio content domains such as songs, playlists, and podcasts. Multi-domain sequential recommendation (MDSR) seeks to exploit such cross-domain behavior, yet two obstacles persist in practice. First, joint optimization across heterogeneous domains is prone to negative transfer, with high-traffic domains dominating the shared parameter space and suppressing weaker domains. Second, conventional ID-based collaborative signals fail to bridge domains that are semantically related but exhibit little behavioral overlap. This paper presents CAMAR, a multi-modal causal disentanglement framework for multi-domain audio recommendation. From a causal perspective, user behavior is modeled as the joint outcome of a domain-invariant preference and domain-specific preferences. translated_title: 面向多领域序列音频推荐的多模态因果解耦方法
translated_abstract: 现代音乐平台使用户接触到歌曲、播放列表和播客等异构的音频内容领域。多领域序列推荐（MDSR）旨在利用这种跨领域行为，但在实践中仍存在两个障碍。其一，在异构领域之间进行联合优化容易产生负迁移，高流量领域会主导共享参数空间并压制较弱领域；其二，传统的基于ID的协同信号无法连接那些语义相关但行为重叠很少的领域。本文提出了CAMAR——一个面向多领域音频推荐的多模态因果解耦框架。从因果视角出发，用户行为被建模为领域不变偏好与领域特定偏好的共同结果。在这一观点的引导下，CAMAR将用户表示分解为领域不变成分和领域特定成分，并强制执行领域（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出多模态因果解耦框架CAMAR，将用户表示分解为领域不变偏好与领域特定偏好，以解决多领域序列音频推荐中的负迁移问题和跨领域行为重叠稀疏的难题。
en_tdlr: CAMAR is proposed, a multi-modal causal disentanglement framework that factorizes user representations into domain-invariant and domain-specific preferences to mitigate negative transfer and sparse cross-domain behavioral overlap in multi-domain sequential audio recommendation.
